qualifying_population.declared_in: docs/receipts/campaign-fingerprints.json wall.P4-S6, and the S6c1 commit body
qualifying_population.rule: S6 deletes two entries from the ordering fold, so DEBUFF_ARM (6), RECOVERY (7) and UTILITY_ARM (8) stop tying on element 1 of the walk's eight-element sort key and resolve in declaration order instead. A snapshot leaf can therefore move only if its walk holds an *inverted pair*: two actions at one timestamp whose keys tie today and whose relative order the split reverses. Everything else re-sorts to the identical sequence, and every other read of a rank is a threshold comparison at a group boundary the surviving REACTIVE/LATE_BARRIER pair does not straddle. Measured by wrapping the walk's entry point and the receipt ledger's walk-authored heal insertion on the pre-edit tree (scratch instruments, R-16: <scratch>/s6/probe_population.py and <scratch>/s6/probe_bench.py).

golden.why: The pair-golden rebuild invokes run_survival_walk ZERO times over the whole snapshot, so the key S6 changes is never built in that jurisdiction. Structurally empty, not assumed empty — D-93's ruling, measured rather than quoted.

coupled_golden.per_scenario: 0 for each of the 13 scenarios; no scenario holds an inverted pair.

outside_both_golden_jurisdictions.what: R-01 row 8's four bench scenarios exercise the optimizer's score path, which neither baseline covers. They are enumerated here because row 8 gates counters, winner and score, and a reordering that moves one of those is an unexpected occurrence exactly as a golden leaf would be.

syndra_mandate_3champ.shape: `Bandlepipes — Fanfare` UTILITY_ARM resolving before `Bandlepipes — Fanfare` DEBUFF_ARM at t=0.0

cassiopeia_5champ.shape: `Twin Fang · Heal` RECOVERY resolving before `Bloodletter's Curse — Vile Decay` DEBUFF_ARM at t=0.0

payload_neutrality.claim: All three split ranks keep the public_phase label they had — DEBUFF_ARM and UTILITY_ARM publish state_transition, RECOVERY publishes healing_and_regeneration — so the derived PARTICIPANT_LEDGER_CONTRACT['phases'] list is byte-identical across the split and CAPABILITY_SCHEMA_VERSION does not move. D-63's chain is unadvanced: S6 takes no value and S9 still takes 4.

measured.bench: All four scenarios identical to the pre-edit reading on every counter family, the residual, the rung histogram, the winner and the score (4003.1 / 3305.0 / 4642.3 / 5010.8). Row 11's routing_divergences is [] for all four.
measured.positive_control: The population probe re-run against the post-edit tree with the PRE-S6 fold restored reproduces the declared reorderings exactly — syndra_mandate_3champ 8 reordering walks / 8 inverted pairs, cassiopeia_5champ 3 / 6 — so the zeros above are a split that landed and moved no number, not an edit that did nothing.
measured.note: Measured after the edit against both committed baselines. Both compares report `snapshot identical`: the campaign's standing coupled difference set is empty at the S5 tip and S6 did not add to it. Zero leaves are attributable to this slice in either jurisdiction, so nothing qualifies under R-15 and no oracle receipt is owed. The declared count and the measured count agree, which is what R-20 asks the declaration to do.
